metadata.description: Claude Code skills and commands used at Cost Effective Software

plugins.name: feedback-workflow
plugins.description: Customer feedback rounds end-to-end: /feedback-prep asks clarifying questions on ClickUp tickets before work starts; /feedback-round consolidates, implements via parallel subagents, and syncs ClickUp/DB/BRD.

plugins.name: brd-architect
plugins.description: One-Shot BRD Architect skill: interview a business owner and produce a build-ready BRD a coding agent can implement in one shot — no follow-up questions, no invented decisions, no gaps.

plugins.name: fix-stale-mcp-oauth
plugins.description: Fix MCP OAuth logins failing with 'Unrecognized client_id': delete the stale Dynamic Client Registration entry from the credentials cache (single key, with backup), restart, re-authenticate — without touching other servers' credentials.

plugins.name: nuxt
plugins.description: Nuxt 4+ development skill with reference docs (server routes, routing, middleware, composables, config). Vendored MIT-licensed community skill, pinned so the whole team runs the same version.
